title: Honnan? -i
summary: Add -i to a place name to say someone or something is from there: Szeged → szegedi.

sections.text: **-i** turns a place into an adjective meaning “from there”. It never changes with vowel harmony, and the word is written with a **small letter**.
Exception: Ausztrália → **ausztrál**. And many countries have their own nationality word instead: Németország → **német**, Franciaország → **francia**, Magyarország → **magyar**.

items.en: I'm from Szeged, but I live in Budapest.

items.hu: Berlinben élek. — És berlini is vagy?
items.en: I live in Berlin. — And are you from Berlin too?
